scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.run: mkdir -p data/recordings data/responses && . .venv/bin/activate && streamlit run app/ui.py --server.address 127.0.0.1 --server.port ${CONDUCTOR_PORT:-8501}
